To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the maximal frequent word sequences are better than the n-grams, and the n-grams are better than the bag-of-words for single text summarization.

(a) the maximal frequent word sequences outperform n-grams in terms of precision and F-measure, (b) the use of word sequence features in a vector model for text summarization is more effective than the use of single words, (c) the use of a vector space model for summarization is more efficient than using a probabilistic model, and (d) using the maximal frequent word sequence features in the vector space model outperforms the use of single word features.

(1) the maximal frequent word sequence model outperforms the n-gram model in terms of ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3; (2) the maximal frequent words model performs better than both n-gram models; (3) the combination of both n-gram and maximal frequent word sequence models outperforms each of them separately; and (4) the combination of n-gram and word sequence models outperform the word sequence and word models.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of maximal frequent word sequences is more suitable for extractive text summaries, since they are more informative and more robust than n-grams.
the n-grams and word sequence information are complementary and can improve the performance of extractive text summarisation.
the maximal frequent word sequence models are more suitable than the n-gram models for single text summarization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the n-grams model outperforms the word sequence model.
the n-grams are better than the maximal frequent word sequences, and the n-grams with n = 2 are better than those with n = 1.
the maximal frequent word sequence model is a better choice than the n-grams model for the task of extractive text summarisation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the n-grams model is more suitable for short text summarization and that the maximal frequent word sequences model is more suitable to long text summarization, especially for documents with more than 1000 words.
